fnol_text: My name is Sofia Raman and I live at 672 Foxglove Way, Dover, DE 19941. You can reach me on (555) 344-7064 or sofia.raman@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 24 July 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00051. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Raman on (555) 344-7064 to acknowledge the claim. Sofia confirmed the loss date as 24 July 2026.
Site visit to 672 Foxglove Way. Neighbour Olusegun Delgado was present and confirmed the timeline.
Sofia sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
